create.name: Susan Kaiser Greenland
create.bio:
Susan Kaiser Greenland is an American mindfulness educator and author who came to meditation while working as a corporate lawyer. The practice reshaped her life, and she went on to adapt it for children, creating the Inner Kids model in the early 2000s: a playful, activity-based way of teaching attention, balance and compassion that became one of the first secular mindfulness programmes offered in schools and community settings, first around Southern California and later far beyond it.

Her first book, The Mindful Child, set out that approach for parents, and Mindful Games, with its companion deck of activity cards, gathered dozens of simple games that families and teachers can use to build focus and steady emotions. Her more recent work speaks to adults as well. Real-World Enlightenment offers fifty short tools drawn from Buddhist teaching, other wisdom traditions and modern psychology, for people who want a calmer, kinder way of living without long retreats or elaborate routines. Her books have been translated into more than a dozen languages, her guided meditations appear on several meditation apps, and her YouTube channel carries short teaching clips and game demonstrations. She divides her time between Los Angeles and Brooklyn.
